assessed_skill: Retrieve the primary trial report, identify its study population and assess direct applicability.

review.question_for_reviewer: 兩版能否區分原始報告的收案事實與對其他族群的推論？

variants.question: 同事在讀書會說，2015 年 SPRINT 主要報告直接研究了有第二型糖尿病的成人。請查原始報告，用兩句話回覆這個說法，附上 PMID 和能核對收案條件的段落。
variants.answer: SPRINT 主要報告的收案對象為心血管風險較高且沒有糖尿病的成人。這份試驗對第二型糖尿病成人的效果無法提供直接估計（PMID 26551272，摘要 Methods 第一句）。
rubric: 正確辨識糖尿病列入排除條件
說明對該族群的直接證據範圍
定位至 2015 年原始報告的收案敘述

variants.question: At journal club, a colleague says the primary 2015 SPRINT report directly studied adults with type 2 diabetes. Look up the primary report and respond in two sentences. Include the PMID and the passage that establishes who was enrolled.
variants.answer: SPRINT enrolled adults at increased cardiovascular risk who did not have diabetes. The trial therefore provides no direct estimate of the treatment effect in adults with type 2 diabetes (PMID 26551272, Abstract, Methods, first sentence).
rubric: Distinguishes the study population from the proposed population
Locates the eligibility statement in the primary 2015 report

evidence.title: A Randomized Trial of Intensive versus Standard Blood-Pressure Control
evidence.locator: Abstract, Methods, first sentence, which reports randomization of 9,361 participants and their diabetes status.
